observations: Three photos show a metallic automotive part, likely a transmission or engine component, held in a hand over a wooden surface.
The part has a rectangular cavity with a central black rubber or plastic element, possibly a gasket or seal.
There are multiple bolt holes and mounting points around the edges.
The surface is dirty, with grime, oil residue, and some greenish paint or rust stains.
Handwritten markings '7' and '2' are visible on the metal surface in all photos.
The background includes a green bucket with tape and a spray can, suggesting a workshop or repair environment.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the part itself.
The seller's text mentions 'Nissan motors> Gasoline engines> Horsepower > High performance☆ and classic☆ fairly used but like...'.
